headline: CSI 300 Climbs 1.7% in Rebound From Bear Market on Suspected State Buying
summary: China's benchmark CSI 300 Index rallied 1.7% to 4,105.33, reversing an earlier sell-off that had entered bear market territory, amid heavy trading volume in state-backed ETFs.
why: The CSI 300 tracks the largest mainland Chinese equities; intervention by state-backed funds often provides a psychological and liquidity floor during market declines.

impacts.name: CSI 300 Index
impacts.why: Surging ETF volumes and suspected sovereign buying reversed bear market losses.

impacts.name: Chinese Equities
impacts.why: State intervention restored short-term sentiment across mainland stock exchanges.

why_moved: Surging volume in major ETFs indicated potential Chinese state fund intervention, lifting the CSI 300 by 1.7% off its bear market lows.
